notes.title: Patch 0.26 is now live on beta branch
notes.content:
[h4]This is the draft patch notes of 0.26, which is currently live on beta branch. The content is subject to change and will be updated. You can switch to beta branch on Steam to access this patch. However, [i]do not downgrade[/i] to stable branch until Patch 0.26 is released![/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/9a989fc49add4922bc029abe8924d84cd5c3a28c.gif[/img]

[h2]Level Boost Great People[/h2]
6 new Information Age great people have been added - they provide level boost to Information Age wonders:
[list]
[*] William Shepherd: +1 Level to International Space Station
[*] Lee Kuan Yew: +1 Level to Marina Bay Sands
[*] Emmanuelle Charpentier: +1 Level to Palm Jumeirah
[*] Dan Alderson: +1 Level to Alderson Disk
[*] Freeman Dyson: +1 Level to Dyson Sphere
[*] Vera Rubin: +1 Level to Matrioshka Brain
[*] Pelé: +1 Level to Itaipu Dam (Brazilian exclusive)
[*] Ludwig van Beethoven: +1 Level to Cologne Cathedral (German exclusive)
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/e8d2bc0c2afe82bfdd024dc28416f15cdbd0ad67.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/d883a200c28fe1c6a026e72564cd21f905bc9f85.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/68bbac0f6c34f4a1d9ec5e335ae015d5e3337607.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/a4f00e16046b9753ac1c0651a0ebab8303f5d268.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/7c3fbd745604d883af66434215ce13b78a24a5cc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/8d873c438d8bbba876011f83318b59cddc9c3f1c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/535fbb0f44ef688ef721f6c149a0c500d1e40c1b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/3ff39b53058bd513e477de35e3c33cb3008d2b14.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/29ff9a1ce5877c2a33e944a872e1772f3cebd041.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/e51c812d71e20015f891c7163625568cb02cdc6f.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/1025884c6f0a01bc21026fc0e45317822bf706ee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/7536b29056b3f0ec57b175484facb742be202c2c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/3d985e68698f19abdc1b40f291704feae65b2657.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/843a368ce48d2ebcae42bdc2e54bb90b496b3d02.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/24b8c024479c09b3fb56233ce10d2daf62aa9689.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/bd9fdba013cbbf53465fc35f389c9b4c1f2f3660.png[/img][/url]

They are not required to upgrade Age Wisdom, and Age Wisdom does not affect them. [b]Zenobia (Classical Age)[/b] is now a Level Boost Great People as well, which means Classical Age Wisdom will no longer affect Zenobia - the shards you've spent on the upgrade will be refunded

[h2]New Civ: Indian[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/994dfa48d943cc1a6b6536d2a2301869b821fba9.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Red Fort: +5 Building Level Boost to all buildings within 4-tile range. This wonder can be upgraded and each additional level provides an extra +1 Building Level Boost
[*] Ganges River: Each type of building within 2-tile radius gets +N Production Multiplier, N = level of Age Wisdom for the age in which the building is unlocked
[*] Sundarbans: Double the effect of all Age Wisdoms
[*] Sanchi Stupa: Transports from or to buildings within 2-tile range are immediate
[*] Qutb Minar: When completed, a great person is born - it can come from any age except the current one. This wonder can be upgraded, and each additional upgrade causes another great person to be born, which can come from any age except the current one. When choosing great people from this wonder, 4 choices are provided
[*] Festival: Diwali: Increase the range of Ganges River to 3-tile. Increase the range of Sanchi Stupa to 3-tile. Double the level boost from Red Fort
[*] Rabindranath Tagore: +2 Production Multiplier, Storage Multiplier for Embassy
[*] Akbar The Great: +1 Level to Red Fort
[/list]

[h2]Warp Speed Improvement Backport[/h2]
The warp speed improvement from Spaceship Idle has been backported to CivIdle: now when running at a higher warp speed, only the extra speed will cost warp.
e.g.:
[list]
[*] At 2x speed, it will cost 1/2 warp per game second (1 warp per wall clock second, previously 2 warp per wall clock second)
[*] At 3x speed, it will cost 2/3 warp per game second (2 warp per wall clock second, previously 3 warp per wall clock second)
[*] At 4x speed, it will cost 3/4 warp per game second (3 warp per wall clock second, previously 4 warp per wall clock second)
[/list]

[h2]United Nations Rework[/h2]
[list]
[*] General Assembly votes now are guaranteed to have one building from each age.
[*] General Assembly now only boosts Production Multiplier and the multiplier is now dynamic (i.e. does not affect storage)
[*] United Nations can now be upgraded, each level provides +1 to General Assembly multipliers
[/list]

[h2]New Tutorial[/h2]
CivIdle has a lot of deep mechanisms, which can be overwhelming for new players. I've added a "step by step" tutorial, that will guide new players through the first run and introduce some important concept along the way. For players who prefer manual style intro, the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3196523559]new player guide[/url] is a good read.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/e60c904cb8f4bea831de27a7eb1c1859c7745399.png[/img]

[h2]"Todo" Tabs[/h2]
Running an empire is no easy task - there are lots of things to consider. A new "Todo" tabs system has been added that will remind you of the important actions to take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/b2e60c3b00e7042b4a104233dc1c61e1c93a789c.png[/img]

They are also color coded: red, amber and green, to indicate the urgency. Clicking the message will take you to the corresponding UI directly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/3f97ab0aba77338a379ec906df96f26a370706b9.png[/img]

If you feel a certain message causes too much noise, you can turn it off.

[h2]Wonder Constructed / Natural Wonder Discovered Popup[/h2]
Sometimes it's easy to miss that you've constructed a wonder, or a natural wonder has been discovered. Not any more with a newly added popup! You can also turn them off if you feel they cause too much noise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/a0ffff9e455b0bf317ad3555cb7de14fc4f9b6e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/e885a1e9d530d1045690f47509fe03d7d7d053b9.png[/img]

[h2]Other QoL & Balancing for New Players[/h2]
[list]
[*] Default Stockpile Input Capacity is now 2 (changed from 1)
[*] Default Max Stockpile is now 25 (changed from 5)
[*] Default Production Priority is now 3 (changed from 1)
[*] Default Construction Priority is now 2 (changed from 1)
[*] Add "Default Wonder Construction Priority" and default to 1
[*] Add "Default Production Priority For Buildings That Produce Workers" and default to 4 
[*] Add a link to Supporter Pack on Steam in Help -> Supporter Pack
[*] Housing now unlocks Production Priority (previously unlocked by Herding)
[*] Herding now unlocks Transport Preference (previously unlocked by Housing)
[*] Construction cost of Statistics Office has been greatly reduced
[/list]

[h2]Trade Tile Reservation Change[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tribune: 1 day (no change)
[*] Quaestor: 3 days (from 7 days)
[*] Aedile: 5 days (from 14 days)
[*] Praetor: 7 days (from 21 days)
[*] Consul: 9 days (from 28 days)
[*] Caesar: 9 days (from 28 days)
[*] Augustus: 9 days (from 28 days)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.25.3: Spinner, Scientific Notations and Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h3]Spinner Customization[/h3]

In this patch, you can customize spinner style. There are a few styles for you to pick from. You can also customize the spinning speed and the opacity (alpha) of the spinner. And if you prefer, you can hide them completely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/5dc1f07f6a19fb73f2935fdc1afccc5509defd6f.gif[/img]

[h3]Scientific Notation for Large Numbers[/h3]

You can choose to use scientific notation for large numbers (>= 1Qa) if you don't like [b]Qa ant Qt[/b]

[h3]Fix Building Level Boost Storage[/h3]

Building Level Boost, which is newly introduced in Patch 0.25.0, [b]should not[/b] affect buildings' storage. However, the previous implementation has bugs and it does affect storage. This has caused full buildings to have less storage than working buildings, which is not correct. This bug has been fixed in this patch.

[h3]Fix Cathedral of Brasília Storage[/h3]

The production multiplier from [b]Cathedral of Brasília[/b] should be marked as dynamic, which does not affect storage. However, it was not and it caused building storage to fluctuate. This bug has ben fixed in this patch.

[h3]Steam 4X Fest[/h3]

We've had a great Steam 4X Fest - there are quite a few new players checking out the game. And I hope the new content in the massive Patch 0.25 have served the existing players well.

For now, I will turn my focus back on Spaceship Idle. The game is being completely rewritten, from an incremental [i]PvP autobattler[/i], towards an incremental [i]4X/grand strategy autobattler[/i]. Here are some screenshot teaser:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/4a00522cfba2f68068052ac66c6056ae794e6664.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/73ff9dd34f5bdeb98ef5926a659ab14c3dcfb662.png[/img]

If you want follow the development, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/xgNxpsM]Discord server[/url]. And if you want to get notified when the game is available, wishlist it on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454630/Spaceship_Idle_Design_Build_Explore__Battle/

notes.title: Patch 0.25.2: Electrification Improvement
notes.content:
[h3]Add Default Electrification Level[/h3]
You can now set a default electrification level in Options -> Gameplay. Setting the building-type specific default electrification level should also work.

The electrification level slider now allows you to go over a building's level - the actual electrification level [i]is still capped[/i] by a building's level.

[h3]Clarify +5 Building Level Boost from Liberalism and Powered Buildings[/h3]
Liberalism Level 5's description has been changed to: [i]All buildings that can be electrified get +5 Building Level Boost for free[/i]

The +5 Building Level Boost are also detached from electrification. They do not show the "Electrified" icon on the top left anymore. They also always work regardless of a building's electrification status. The "Electrified" icon has been changed from a bolt to a battery to distinguish from the power grid icon (which is a bolt). All icons on the top left are no longer colored: it should make them more readable from building icons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/4581b3a361bfa4445329c9930a0a5d54b963681b.png[/img]

[h3]Increase Stockpile Input Capacity and Max Stockpile[/h3]
Stockpile Input Capacity is now capped at 20x (from 10x) and Max Stockpile is now capped at 100x (from 50x). This should help with managing bigger maps

notes.title: Patch 0.25: Brazilian, Rework Electrification & Concrete, New Great People...
notes.content:
[h4]Patch 0.25 has [i]lots of[/i] new content and I've hit the Steam Patch Notes title character limit - you can read all the detail changes in this patch notes. Please note because there are new resources introduced, [i]you need to update to Patch 0.25 to see the player trade map[/i][/h4]

[h2]New Civilization: Brazilian[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/11b1d52b7bdd55365b6968252f4f72383bbbb44a.png[/img]

[h2]Electrification Reworked[/h2]

The current electrification system is a bit underwhelming - it does not scale well with production multiplier. Here's how the new electrification system works:

[list]
[*] Electrification gives "[i]Building Level Boost[/i]" instead of increasing consumption and production multipliers
[*] The additional levels do not affect Storage and Workers
[*] Buildings that require power get +5 Building Level Boost as a base
[*] Liberalism V now gives +5 Building Level Boost to all buildings
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/b4e2c4c7770bfc4e2d0906a02b944467ab8c46ef.gif[/img]

[h2]Construction Materials Reworked[/h2]

If you've reached Industrial Age, you must have encountered the problem: where do I get so much concrete? Concrete, as the "top end" of the construction material, is simply too cheap. Thus, the amount required for wonders can be hard to manage sometimes. In this patch, two new construction materials have been added:

[list]
[*] [b]Rebar[/b]: 5 Steel -> 1 Rebar (Unlocked by Railway, Industrial)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/97430e3c63c23b4fadc735609ff46f79227783a2.png[/img]
[*] [b]Reinforced Concrete[/b]: 5 Rebar + 5 Concrete -> 1 Reinforced Concrete (Unlocked by Electricity, Industrial)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/f4ffe0c0176f6d69c5fb24b26045010a12a36629.png[/img]
[/list]

And Concrete Plant's resource has been changed to:

[list]
[*] Concrete: 5 Brick + 5 Sand + 5 Tool -> 1 Concrete
[/list]

The following building's construction material has been changed:

[list]
[*] Condo: from 3 Concrete to 3 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Uranium Mine:  from 1 Concrete to 1 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Uranium Enrichment Plant:  from 4 Concrete to 4 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Hydro Dam:  from 1 Concrete to 1 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Nuclear Power Plant:  from 16 Concrete to 16 Reinforced Concrete
[/list]

The following wonders' [b]construction material[/b] has been changed from [b]Concrete[/b] to [b]Reinforced Concrete[/b]:
[list]
[*] Brandenburg Gate
[*] Cristo Redentor
[*] Tower Bridge
[/list]

A new great person has been added that provides +1 Production and Storage multiplier to Rebar Plant and Reinforced Concrete Plant:

[list]
[*] Joseph Monier (1823 ~ 1906)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/a84963423f6f731b2466ed17ac692037ac59fa2c.png[/img]

[h2]Adaptive Great People[/h2]

Nine new great people have been added: one for each age (except for Stone Age). [b]They provide +1 Production and Storage Multiplier for a select building unlocked in the corresponding age[/b]. Once a building is selected, it cannot be changed for the current run. Buildings that provide workers cannot be selected.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/63881d8955408329a0713c887c94aa0eaa7536c9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/22945522abedaa600149f0eccd58559e4bf721f2.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/4f841dcb43f35324f7b9729a50a78251baec0168.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/46c2fe46a88f4e0dd7162ee2f5f9bfe71a6bd5c5.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/bbcab2ba7c416a6d57c215039e398710b3163825.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/2c5a056ae3b2dbc89b194aee207e4fd6569151db.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c84f52edb0f894c36a5ff5461cef1f51f1592733.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/ee9dd6096d74ec395e28f0d64fa0c2073d985ca7.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/f866193d5f643e566489d0c0fc2f67c8c200f420.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/6fdd1800df7d9a75d92d121fb089b01524de9594.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/0f4b8c4a1fc4549c81a0418a74f4343f78b3f04b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/9b15f4671d7ecff0248c1b68ad739876d1143228.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/fc63948202c6f0e976d51d8eafffba26eb8cd99e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/e43fbb83b80469a2684cc52d671298dc8a04f741.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/9668903372daa5d489a06714d191fd82ed5436ed.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/24877934d560ad788ee3f5be2b0af67d55efd657.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c77e3693efaf362eb432cdb6442429dd58ec8737.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/e8047a44bfeda79985f57d4d689f53f0222ae7fa.png[/img][/url]

These new Great People are [i]not eligible for Age Wisdom[/i] (they are not needed for Age Wisdom and Age Wisdom does not affect them). Broadway (Wonder) and Pamukkale (Natural Wonder) work for them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/680bbe3e6b57d800777fd74eb06700fe178159b7.png[/img]


[h2]Trade Alliance Change[/h2]

Trade Alliance is introduced in Patch 0.24. It is well received, however, using country flag as the alliance condition is less optimal. In this patch, the condition is now based on [b]playing the same civilization[/b]. On the trade map, you can now see what civilization a player is playing. You can also see what age the player is at as well.

[h2]Swiss Bank Change[/h2]

[list]
[*] Swiss Bank no longer needs to be built around warehouses. It can now convert resources from all player tradable resources (i.e. caravansary and its connected warehouses)
[*] Swiss Bank can be electrified now
[*] You can now disable Koti export of Swiss Bank: buildings will no longer pull Koti from Swiss Bank
[*] Two new Cold Wars great people have been added: Friedrich Hayek provides +1 Production Multiplier for Swiss Bank and Paul Samuelson provides +1 Building Level Boost for Swiss Bank. Both great people are required for Cold Wars age wisdom and Cold Wars age wisdom also affects both.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/b1fa4030e7135274fac5c0a055b7b34f8f227097.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/0c4fde3249bbaa5358667b5de79cbdd01cf0c20c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/b5f9790312d2ba70f2f4839e3f9a4c916a871e3e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/b0416dcc4d91d9cf1a1cd85820c21223a17754c8.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

You can see the detail breakdown of tradable resources, building level boosts and production multipliers in the Swiss Bank UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/d7ecef10183bc8b6e560fba0b772f24627650846.png[/img]

[h2]More Achievements[/h2]

The following achievements have been added:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/760537592e05f856fafc776b8b6166e7fa6c880b.png[/img]

[h2]New Honorary Account Rank[/h2]

Two new account ranks have been added: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/11fc45ef872cb77e27a41a664e364f7924d86448.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c067afa679cf965ab9c38649eafcfaf4f7a6ecf4.png[/img]

When you've reached 1500 hours of play time and 1500 Effective Great People Level, you will receive Caesar Rank.

When you've reached 2000 hours of play time and 2000 Effective Great People Level, you will receive Augustus Rank.

These two ranks are honorary at the moment: they have the same privileges as [b]Consul[/b]

[h2]Light Tile Improvement[/h2]

There were lots of hard coded "white" color in code that does not work well with the new light tile. I have gone through all of them so that they will render appropriate color based on light or dark tile.

[h2]Effective Great People Level Bugfix[/h2]

In previous versions, effective great people level are calculated incorrectly: Civ-specific, Wildcard and Promotion great people are not required to upgrade Age Wisdom, yet they are counted into Age Wisdom when calculating effective great people level. This has been fixed and you might notice some changes in your effective great people level. Account ranks are not retrospectively fixed so if your new effective great people level is below the threshold with this change, you will keep your old rank.

[h2]Performance Optimization[/h2]

It's been a while since I've done performance optimization. The performance keeps degrading as more features are added. In this patch, I have shipped several optimizations that should work out of the box and hopefully will reduce the stutter that happens every second.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] You can now remap "Middle Click Copy" feature to "Right Click"
[*] Fix a bug where Petra's empire value is not calculated correctly
[/list]

Cheers,
FishPond

[*] [b]Rebar[/b]: 5 Steel -> 1 Rebar (Unlocked by Railway, Industrial)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/97430e3c63c23b4fadc735609ff46f79227783a2.png[/img]
[*] [b]Reinforced Concrete[/b]: 5 Rebar + 5 Concrete -> 1 Reinforced Concrete (Unlocked by Electricity, Industrial)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/f4ffe0c0176f6d69c5fb24b26045010a12a36629.png[/img]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Concrete: 5 Brick + 5 Sand + 5 Tool -> 1 Concrete
[/list]

The following building's construction material has been changed:

[list]
[*] Condo: from 3 Concrete to 3 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Uranium Mine:  from 1 Concrete to 1 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Uranium Enrichment Plant:  from 4 Concrete to 4 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Hydro Dam:  from 1 Concrete to 1 Reinforced Concrete
[*] Nuclear Power Plant:  from 16 Concrete to 16 Reinforced Concrete
[/list]

The following wonders' [b]construction material[/b] has been changed from [b]Concrete[/b] to [b]Reinforced Concrete[/b]:
[list]
[*] Brandenburg Gate
[*] Cristo Redentor
[*] Tower Bridge
[/list]

A new great person has been added that provides +1 Production and Storage multiplier to Rebar Plant and Reinforced Concrete Plant:

[list]
[*] Joseph Monier (1823 ~ 1906)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/a84963423f6f731b2466ed17ac692037ac59fa2c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/680bbe3e6b57d800777fd74eb06700fe178159b7.png[/img]


[h2]Trade Alliance Change[/h2]

Trade Alliance is introduced in Patch 0.24. It is well received, however, using country flag as the alliance condition is less optimal. In this patch, the condition is now based on [b]playing the same civilization[/b]. On the trade map, you can now see what civilization a player is playing. You can also see what age the player is at as well.

[h2]Swiss Bank Change[/h2]

[list]
[*] Swiss Bank no longer needs to be built around warehouses. It can now convert resources from all player tradable resources (i.e. caravansary and its connected warehouses)
[*] Swiss Bank can be electrified now
[*] You can now disable Koti export of Swiss Bank: buildings will no longer pull Koti from Swiss Bank
[*] Two new Cold Wars great people have been added: Friedrich Hayek provides +1 Production Multiplier for Swiss Bank and Paul Samuelson provides +1 Building Level Boost for Swiss Bank. Both great people are required for Cold Wars age wisdom and Cold Wars age wisdom also affects both.

[/list]

You can see the detail breakdown of tradable resources, building level boosts and production multipliers in the Swiss Bank UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/d7ecef10183bc8b6e560fba0b772f24627650846.png[/img]

[h2]More Achievements[/h2]

The following achievements have been added:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/760537592e05f856fafc776b8b6166e7fa6c880b.png[/img]

[h2]New Honorary Account Rank[/h2]

Two new account ranks have been added: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/11fc45ef872cb77e27a41a664e364f7924d86448.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c067afa679cf965ab9c38649eafcfaf4f7a6ecf4.png[/img]

When you've reached 1500 hours of play time and 1500 Effective Great People Level, you will receive Caesar Rank.

When you've reached 2000 hours of play time and 2000 Effective Great People Level, you will receive Augustus Rank.

These two ranks are honorary at the moment: they have the same privileges as [b]Consul[/b]

[h2]Light Tile Improvement[/h2]

There were lots of hard coded "white" color in code that does not work well with the new light tile. I have gone through all of them so that they will render appropriate color based on light or dark tile.

[h2]Effective Great People Level Bugfix[/h2]

In previous versions, effective great people level are calculated incorrectly: Civ-specific, Wildcard and Promotion great people are not required to upgrade Age Wisdom, yet they are counted into Age Wisdom when calculating effective great people level. This has been fixed and you might notice some changes in your effective great people level. Account ranks are not retrospectively fixed so if your new effective great people level is below the threshold with this change, you will keep your old rank.

[h2]Performance Optimization[/h2]

It's been a while since I've done performance optimization. The performance keeps degrading as more features are added. In this patch, I have shipped several optimizations that should work out of the box and hopefully will reduce the stutter that happens every second.

Cheers,
FishPond

[h2]New Civilization: Ottoman[/h2]

A new Civilization [b]Ottoman[/b] has been added, featuring 1 unique building, 2 unique wonders and 3 unique natural wonders.

Swiss Bank is unlocked by [i]Monetary System (Cold War)[/i] and allows you to convert a chosen resource from adjacent warehouses to Koti (10 million in Sanskrit) - a tradeable resource that is worth 10M value. Each level of Swiss Bank add 1 Koti conversion per cycle, which is affected by Production Multiplier. Swiss Bank can store unlimited amount of Koti.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/d80c0cfdac273db4e1f5b207a28496da9ecb8267.png[/img]

[h2]Trade Tile Expansion[/h2]
In this patch, apart from trade tile entitlement from account rank, an owned/occupied tile generates [b]0.005[/b] tile point per hour ([i]up to 7 days from the first claimed tile[/i]). [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c9b837751dcd89a6f555aa2cd0ec61448ac23d3e.png[/img]

[h2]Trade Neighbor & Ally[/h2]
You get +1 Production Multiplier for each neighbor's tile, and +2 Production Multiplier for each ally's tile. To become an ally with your neighbor, choose the same flag (except for the Earth flag) as them. Players with the Earth flag are neutral and cannot be allied with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/5e71470c9f73b616776082ac19051b71f383a313.png[/img]

[h2]Highlight Trade Tile Bonus[/h2]
This is the most requested feature since the introduction of trade tile bonus. Now you can not only highlight all tiles with a certain bonus, but also cycle through them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/fe9bab985504ca701e125585846dc09dfe13629c.gif[/img]

You can also highlight multiple buildings at the same type - so you can pick the best spot for your empire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c2683a6c13dcefc9affc68637eb2d169d2f02b61.gif[/img]

While working on Spaceship Idle, I have backported several engine improvements back to CivIdle. One of them is support for new tile visuals. I've added several options (some of them require supporter pack), including light tiles, in case that's your preference. [i]Also, players with Aedile or above rank can now link GIFs in chat.[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/5b014fa88a1f6c6266fd751e528dc01193dcda47.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/66af85e4fbbee33bdf4a1a3f06ffd3b2f7894596.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/704f54739d9050e1e494e763ecb5592a24577094.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/25207421462dcee4226611322166fa9ccb569a37.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/69e0382a410f19cedd275d57bb0b86045728a537.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/44f6524a1be9002f70a207c75cbaf7b3d78a390a.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/97ad425d92b0a2bed74b859ea9b9e0572ab55035.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/f978873ecf54495c06a3ca5fa8e0a0360baefed4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]
The following achievements has been added to Steam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/705c65add9a369d0fc2294ba882dc6c516c83b18.png[/img]

This is also backported from Spaceship Idle. Previously, the save system can occasionally corrupt the save file. Even though there's an automatic backup system, hopefully this improvement will make the backup system redundant.

notes.title: Patch 0.23: French + Easter Bunny + Trade Expansion
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that Patch 0.23 is now available to all players. This patch is one of the biggest: a new civilization, a holiday event, significant player trade expansion, plus new achievements - it has stuff for everyone!

Also, before the patch notes, I'd like to address an often asked question. As you probably know, I have started to work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454630/Spaceship_Idle/]Spaceship Idle[/url], a spiritual successor to this game. [b]However, that doesn't mean I am done with CivIdle, not yet at least[/b]. I still have some ideas for content that I'd like to bring to the game. And I have been backporting lots of the design I have for Spaceship Idle to CivIdle (trade diplomacy being one of them).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454630/Spaceship_Idle/

As I am the only developer and only working on my free time, I have extremely limited resources - and I need to spend it wisely. I plan to make a playable build of Spaceship Idle soon-ish, therefore, Patch 0.24 will take longer than usual, most likely after the alpha test of Spaceship Idle. The alpha test of Spaceship Idle will be announced in our [url=https://discord.gg/Z3kFpawyts]Discord Server[/url] and will first open for experienced players of CivIdle and Industry Idle. If you are interested, hop onto our server and watch for the announcement. And if alpha test is not for you, you can always wishlist it on Steam to get notified when the game is available.

[h2]New Civilization: French[/h2]

[h3]World Wonders[/h3]
[list]
[*] Louvre: For every 10 Extra Great People at Rebirth, one great person from all unlocked ages is born
[*] Centre Pompidou: Once constructed, all buildings get +1 Production and +2 Storage Multiplier. The wonder will persist if the current run reaches Information Age and the next run is a different civilization. The wonder gets +1 level at rebirth for each run that reaches Information Age with a unique civilization. Each level provides +1 Production and +2 Storage Multiplier. The value of this wonder is excluded from total empire value and British Museum cannot transform into this wonder
[*] Mont Saint-Michel: Generate Culture from Idle Workers. Provide +1 Storage Multiplier to all buildings within 2-tile range. This wonder can be upgraded using the generated Culture and each level provides addtional +1 Storage Multiplier
[*] Arc de Triomphe: Every 1 happiness (capped) provides +1 builder capacity to all buildings
[/list]
[h3]Natural Wonders[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dune of Pilat: In each age, double the age wisdom for the previous age
[/list]
[h3]Festival[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bastille Day: Double the effect of Centre Pompidou and Arc de Triomphe. Double the Culture generation from Mont Saint-Michel
[/list]
[h3]Great People[/h3]
[list]
[*] Voltaire: +2 Production Multiplier, Storage Multiplier for Museum
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/ae95d13f57040e66313f989e90b480dc41454eae.png[/img]
[h2]Holiday Event[/h2]
[list]
[*] Easter Bunny: Once constructed, 10% of the extra Great People at Rebirth from this run will carry forward to the next run and are born after building the Easter Bunny in the new run. This wonder can only be constructed during April
[/list]

[h2]Trade Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*] Account with higher ranks can occupy more tiles adjacent to the home tile (1 extra tile for Quaestor, 2 for Aedile, 3 for Praetor and 4 for Consul)
[*] Each trade tile will provides +5 Production Multiplier to a certain building and will be shuffled every week
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/c43c4a4da3581c10e2bc1d2ecb3a7bf1435166bf.png[/img]
[i]In addition to the above, I have also made a proposal to the community to further expand this into a "trade diplomacy" system:[/i]

[h3]Proposed Stage 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Occupying a tile for 24h generates 0.2 army. Your own tile always generates 1 army for 24h
[*] Each army can be used to occupy an empty adjacent tile, or defend an existing tile

notes.title: Patch 0.20: Priority Reworked + Lunar New Year
notes.content:
[h2]Priority Reworked[/h2]
The game's priority system used to work as follows: for 3 buildings A, B, C, if the priority is A > B > C, the order is:

[olist]
[*] Building A transports
[*] Building A produces
[*] Building B transports
[*] Building B produces
[*] Building C transports
[*] Building C produces
[/olist]
This makes sense at the first glance. However, it has some consequences. Most notably, if Building C requires a resource that Building B produces, then the resources that B produces will go straight to building C, which has the lowest priority. After this patch, the order is now:

[olist]
[*] Building A transports
[*] Building B transports
[*] Building C transports
[*] Building A produces
[*] Building B produces
[*] Building C produces
[/olist]
With this change, the problem above should no longer be the case.

[h2]Lunar New Year[/h2]
Year of the Snake: After completed, when entering a new age, instead of getting one great person of each unlocked age, get the same amount of great people in the current age. All buildings within 2-tile range get +1 Production Multiplier. This wonder can be upgraded and each additional upgrade provides +1 Production Multiplier to buidlings within 2-tile range. This wonder can only be constructed during the lunar new year period (1.20 ~ 2.10)

[h2]Offline Production Tweak[/h2]
Offline Production has been changed in this patch. Now you will get 4h of warp storage without Petra and you can do 2x speed. Petra will add additional warp storage (1h for 1 level, same as before) and unlock 16x warp speed. You can set warp speed in your Home Building and Petra. To adjust the split of offline production and time warp, you can go to Options -> Gameplay

[h2]Cross Platform Cloud Save (Beta)[/h2]
Cross Platform Cloud Save allows you to sync your progress from Steam to mobile devices. It is currently in beta and if you are interested in testing this, join our Discord channel and ping @fishpond

Currently, only Android is supported, you can get the beta build on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cividle

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Allow setting a different font scale / panel width setting for mobile
[*]  Add cache for great people images - this should speed up when great people images are first generated
[/list]

[*]  Petra: now allows up to 16x speed up (if your CPU can run the simulation at that speed)

[h2]Performance Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Smooth Ticking: the game does logic calculations of each cycle in one frame before - it is quite fast for a small empire but as the empire grows, the calculation takes longer, resulting in frame rate drops. This optimization will instead spread the calculation among all frames within a cycle, which can help eliminate the frame rate drops. However, it will not reduce the total computation time (in fact it might even increase a bit due to overhead)
[*]  Transport Plan Cache: Every cycle, each building calculates the best transport plan based on its settings - this process requires high CPU power. Enabling Transport Plan Cache will attempt to cache the result of the transport plan if it is still valid and therefore reduce CPU usage and frame rate drop. This would significantly speed up the logic computations. It needs to be turned on manually in Options -> Gameplay -> Performance
[/list]

In this version, tutorials have been revamped - instead of a wall of text when you first start the game, now the tutorial will pop up when certain mechanisms become available. The "contextual tutorial" covers the following topic: Happiness / Wonder / Great People / Science / Worker / Storage / Tradition / Electricity. notes.title: Patch 0.5.0: The World Wars Era!
notes.content:
[b]This is the biggest patch since the early access launch[/b]: it took me hours to collect all the changes and I am sure I have missed a lot. Not only we get a new era (World Wars) with 16 new buildings, 6 new wonders, 7 new great people and lots of significant gameplay changes! Also the balancing of the game has been improved to make new eras feel more significant and make longer runs more viable. The permanent great people carry-over rule for Tribune rank up has been relaxed to make it more friendly for new players while helping keep bots/spammers/cheaters away and keep the game completely free for everyone.

Also Devonin has written an extremely helpful new player guide. If you are new to the game, be sure to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3196523559]check it out![/url]

[b]Here are the patch notes:[/b]

[h3]World War Buildings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Biplane Factory: Engine x1 + Steel x1 + Lens x1 + Petrol x5 => Biplane x1
[*] Plastics Factory: Oil x2 => Plastics x1
[*] Gas Power Plant: Natural Gas x2 => Power x3
[*] Uranium Mine: (Uranium Deposit) => Uranium x1
[*] Movie Studio: Sports x5 + Lens x5 + Garment x5 => Movie x1
[*] Car Factory: Engine x1 + Steel x1 + Furniture x1 + Cable x1 + Plastics x1 + Petrol x5 => Car x1
[*] Artillery Factory: Gatling Gun x1 + Dynamite x1 + Aluminum x5 => Artillery x1
[*] Uranium Enrichment Plant: Uranium x10 => Nuclear Fuel Rod x1
[*] Radio Station: Magazine x5 + Newspaper x5 + Culture x5 => Radio x1
[*] Rocket Factory: Engine x1 + Artillery x1 + Steel x5 + Cable x5 + Petrol x10 => Rocket x1
[*] Battleship Builder: Ironclad x1 + Artillery x1 + Cable x5 + Steel x5 + Aluminum x5 => Battleship x1
[*] Atomic Facility: Dynamite x10 + Uranium x10 => Atomic Bomb x1
[*] Hydro Dam: (Water Deposit) => Water x1 + Power x2
[*] Embassy: Law x5 + Politics x5 + Philosophy x5 => Diplomacy x1
[*] Cable Factory: Copper x5 => Cable x1
[*] Research Lab: Culture x2 + Philosophy x2 => Science x5560
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/0cf7b32c9bdccf720f8ee52457b4d606392dbaa7.png[/img]

[h3]World War Wonders[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hollywood: +5 Happiness. +1 Happiness for each well-stocked building that consumes or produces culture within 2 tile range
[*] Manhattan Project: All uranium mines get +2 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier. Uranium enrichment plants and atomic facilities get +1 Production Multiplier for each adjacent uranium mine that is built on top of a uranium deposit
[*] Golden Gate Bridge: All power plants get +1 Production Multiplier. Provide power to all tiles within 2 tile range
[*] Cristo Redentor: All buildings within 2 tile range are exempt from -1 Happiness
[*] Sagrada Familia: All buildings within 2 tile range get +N Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multipliers. N = max tier difference among adjacent buildings
[*] United Nations: All Tier IV and V and VI buildings get +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier. Participate in UN General Assembly and vote for an additional boost each week
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/d1717a9322cca3a86bd4b343d8acb7a1212d8ef2.png[/img]

[h3]World Wars Great People[/h3]
[list]
[*] Herodotus now boosts Paper Maker instead of Writer's Guild
[*] Shakespeare now boosts Writers Guild instead of Paper Maker
[*] John D. Rockefeller: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Oil Well + Stock Exchange
[*] Rudolf Diesel: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Oil Refinery + Locomotive Factory
[*] Pierre de Coubertin: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Publishing House + Stadium
[*] Charles Parsons: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Coal Power Plant + Ironclad Builder
[*] Richard Jordan Gatling: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Gatling Gun Factory + Tank Factory
[*] Joseph Pulitzer: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Magazine Publisher + Pizzeria
[*] Charles Martin Hall: +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier for Natural Gas Well + Aluminum Smelter
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/f7b84b884571860f5344ae9b4564c2fa16d35940.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buildings that produce science will continue to produce science even if its storage is full (if there's another output, the other output will not be produced)
[*] Each level of permanent Great People provides 5 workers in your Home Building
[*] The number of workers required for production has been changed to the sum of all resources consumed and produced after multipliers (except electrification). Resources that do not take storage (e.g. Science or Power) do not count
[*] All buildings that produce science get ~2.5x more science output
[*] Electricity has been reworked: now power plants will provide power to adjacent tiles. Certain buildings will require power to function and need to be built on top of a tile with power - they also extend the power grid to its adjacent tiles. Electrification is more efficient for buildings that require power.
[*] Offline time should now be more reliable. Thanks to all players providing logs and reports, I have located the main reason why sometimes offline production is missing. This usually happens when the initial connection to the server is timed out (either due to a network hiccup or Steam authentication API timeout). Eventually, when the connection is established, the game has already been running for a while and the server will refuse to grant offline time due to the mismatch. I have added a special handling of this case. If this happens, the whole offline time will be converted to warp in Petra (because offline production is no longer possible). You will get an in-game notification about this.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase the empire value of deposits that are discovered in later ages. This will trickle down to all the downstream resources
[*] Increase the empire value of resources that require more types of input to produce, see: [url=https://discord.com/channels/631551126377857044/1218571470457016361/1218571470457016361]https://discord.com/channels/631551126377857044/1218571470457016361/1218571470457016361[/url]
[*] Streamline wonder building cost: most wonders should see a reduction in building cost, with more in later ages. This means if you upgrade from 0.4.x, your empire value might decrease due to this, see: [url=https://discord.com/channels/631551126377857044/1102225155830317136/1221426548423266434]https://discord.com/channels/631551126377857044/1102225155830317136/1221426548423266434[/url]
[*] University: Poem x2 + Faith x2 => Philosophy x1 + Science x250
[*] Museum: Music x2 + Painting x2 => Culture x1
[*] Publishing House: Philosophy x2 + Book x10 => Newspaper x1 + Science x400
[*] Magazine Publisher: Sports x2 + Book x10 => Magazine x1 + Science x400
[*] Parliament: Culture x2 + Philosophy x2 + Law x2 => Politics x1
[*] Parthenon: Two great people of Classical Age are born and you get 4 choices for each. Musician's Guilds and Painter's Guilds get +1 Production, Worker Capacity and Storage Multiplier and are exempt from -1 Happiness
[*] Taj Mahal: A great person of Classical Age and a great person of Middle Age are born. +5 Builder Capacity Multiplier when upgrading buildings over Level 20
[*] Calendar (Iron Age), Physics (Middle Age), Steam Engine (Industrial) each provides +1 Storage Multiplier for all buildings
[*] Geography (Middle Age) now provides +1 Production Multiplier for Library
[*] Optics (Renaissance) now provides +1 Production Multiplier for School and Library
[*] Capitalism (Industrial) now provides +1 Production Multiplier for School, Library and University
[*] AtomicTheory (World Wars) now provides + 1 Production Multiplier for Library, School, University and Publishing House
[/list]

[h3]Permanent Great People Carry Over Change for Tribune Rank Up (Rank 1 -> 2)[/h3]
You can play the full game as Tribune if you do not plan to participate in the optional online features. To acquire unrestricted access to the online features, you will need to upgrade to Quaestor. This is an anti-bot measure to keep the game free for everyone. Previously permanent great people up to level 2 can be carried over, this has been relaxed as follows:

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.2.0 - 10 New Great People, 3 New Wonders and 2 Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
It's been a week since the early access release! Since then, we have had 12 small patches: fixing bugs and improving QoL. In fact, lots of important QoLs like [b]Transport Preference, Max Transport Distance, Favorite Buildings, and Parallel Construction Transports[/b] have been shipped in these daily patches.

We have also reached more than 1,000 concurrent players! (SteamDB reports 1,060, and the game server reports 1,221). The server has been under stress but luckily there were only 2 crashes, both happened while I was awake so I was able to minimize the impact. Also, I am happy to see lots of players have reached Quaestor - I know the 48-hour playtime requirement is annoying, but it is the only viable way to keep the server running and keep the base game free.

I am grateful for the support I get from our community: we have volunteer moderators helping with game chat, we have translators helping localize the game ([b]Now CivIdle speaks 11 languages![/b]), and I have received several donations from the players helping cover the server expense. If you want to support the game and keep it running, I will release a "Supporter Pack" on Steam in the future, with some extra perks. If you have donated, feel free to ping me (@FishPond on Discord) and I will give you a supporter pack key when it is available.

We also have 100+ reviews on Steam at 75% positive (as of writing). For those of you who enjoyed this game, I hope you will enjoy this content patch! And for those of you who didn't, I know this game has rough edges here and there but I am trying my best to make it better every day and I hope at some point you will give it another chance.

notes.title: Cividle Early Access Release Date: Feb. 16
notes.content:
[h3]Achievement For Playtesters and Demo Players[/h3]

First of all, I want to say thank you to all of you who have played the game's demo during Steam Next Fest. Despite the technical issues with Steam Cloud and server crashes, you guys have been playing the demo and providing valuable feedback. As a thank you, [b]every player who has participated in the playtest or has played the game's demo before the end of Steam Next Fest (Feb 12, 2024 10:00am Pacific) will be awarded with a special Steam achievement: "Founder"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43106564/65233fce6e32ce4e56a3ab2bb8ea98cc59109d6e.png[/img]

[b][i]Update: I have received several feedback about time-locked achievement. I will later on adding ways to unlock this achievement by playing the game, more on that later[/i][/b]

[h3]Demo Progress Will Be Transferred to Early Access Release[/h3]

It's always been my intention to transfer all the demo progress to release. However, the Steam Next Fest demo has been plagued with Steam Cloud issues. The good news is that after patch 0.1.129, this should have been resolved. [b]The demo version will be available until the release[/b] and the release version of the game should be able to [b]automatically pick up your demo progress[/b]. Obviously, this process can go wrong and it's impossible for me to test. So here are some extra precautions:
[olist]
[*]You can make a backup of your demo progress at [b]%appdata%\CivIdleSaves\<Your Steam ID>\CivIdle[/b]
[*]In case the progress transfer failed, you can recover your progress by replacing the save file above with your backup when the game is closed
[/olist]

[h3]Early Access Release Is Only the Beginning[/h3]

If you've played my previous game Industry Idle, you will know that early access is only the beginning. In fact, more than 80% of Industry Idle's content was added after early access release. I have the same plan for CivIdle: currently, CivIdle has 100+ tech tree unlocks, 100+ buildings, including 30+ wonders, and 2 maps. And there are only more to come! I will announce the content plan after early access. Right now, my focus is to squeeze the last bugs from the game.

[h3]Help Spread The Word[/h3]

If you enjoy the game, I would appreciate if you can:
[list]
[*][b]Wishlist the Game Now[/b]
[*][b]Leave a Steam Review After Early Access Release[/b]
[*][b]Help Spread the Word[/b]
[/list]

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[b]Is the game free? How do you monetize the game?[/b]

The game will be released on Steam as a free game. There will be [b]no microtransactions[/b]. All content as of release will be unlockable for free.

At some point after early access release, I will introduce an optional [b]Supporter Pack[/b] that provides extra content, perks, etc. All the income from the sales of the supporter pack will be used to cover the server bill and keep the server running.

[b]Why is there a 48-hour active playtime requirement to rank up to Quaestor?[/b]

As mentioned above, I pay for the game's server currently out of my own pocket. The server has anti-cheat measures to ensure that cheaters do not ruin the game for everybody. However, the anti-cheat is very expensive to run. Because the game is free, according to my experience running Industry Idle, there will be lots of spam, bots, and cheaters. Running anti-cheat for everyone will make the game unsustainable (Industry Idle suffers a lot from this problem). The 48-hour active play time requirement is a cheap way to rule out spam, bots, and cheaters and keep the game free for actual players.

[i]When the supporter pack is introduced, players who purchased the supporter pack will be able to skip this requirement.[/i]

[b]Why Permanent Great People Capped at Level 2 When Upgrading To Quaestor?[/b]

As mentioned above, server anti-cheat is not activated for players with Tribune level. And to make sure everyone has a fair start, the server will only recognize Permanent Great People capped up to level 2, to prevent cheaters from ruining the game's player-driven economy.

[b]What Will Happen to Industry Idle?[/b]

Industry Idle has been content complete for a while, even though it is technically still "early access". I will move the game out of early access when I get around to the paperwork. The server will be kept running as long as I can afford. [b]In fact, the income from both CivIdle and Industry Idle will be pooled together to support both games.[/b]
